module.purpose: Defines createSelectorCreator, a factory that returns a customized createSelector function with configurable memoization (memoize and argsMemoize), and exports a default createSelector instance using weakMapMemoize.
module.summary: This module is part of Reselect. It provides a factory function that builds specialized selector creators. The factory accepts either an options object or a memoize function (with optional extra args) and returns a closure that creates memoized output selectors. Selectors track recomputation counts, support per-selector options overrides, and run extra development-mode stability/identity checks when not in production. A pre-typed withTypes helper is attached. The file also exports a ready-to-use createSelector configured with weakMapMemoize.
module.businessContext: Reselect library core: enables memoized derived state selection for Redux/React. Failure causes excessive recomputation, broken selector memoization, or dev-check omissions.

detail.name: createSelector
detail.signature: createSelector< InputSelectors extends SelectorArray, Result, OverrideMemoizeFunction extends UnknownMemoizer = MemoizeFunction, OverrideArgsMemoizeFunction extends UnknownMemoizer = ArgsMemoizeFunction >(...createSelectorArgs: [...inputSelectors: [...InputSelectors], combiner: Combiner<InputSelectors, Result>, createSelectorOptions?: CreateSelectorOptions<MemoizeFunction, ArgsMemoizeFunction, OverrideMemoizeFunction, OverrideArgsMemoizeFunction>]): MemoizedSelector<InputSelectors, Result, OverrideMemoizeFunction, OverrideArgsMemoizeFunction>
preconditions: At least two arguments must be provided: one or more input selectors followed by a combiner function (or options object plus combiner).
The last non-options argument must be a function (the combiner).
Input selectors passed as rest parameters must be valid selector functions.
postconditions: Returns a MemoizedSelector that caches its result based on the memoization functions derived from combined options.
The returned selector exposes recomputations, resultFunc, and isRecomputed properties for introspection.
When called with the same arguments as a previous invocation where no input selector recomputed, returns the cached result without invoking the combiner.
When called with arguments that produce new results from any input selector, recomputes and caches the new result.
invariants: The recomputations counter increments every time the memoized combiner is executed.
The dependencyRecomputations counter increments on every invocation of the arguments checker (before short-circuiting).
lastResult always holds the most recently computed value of the combiner.
The returned selector preserves referential equality of input selector results through the argsMemoize layer.
edgeCases: If the final argument is an object instead of a function, it is treated as an options object and the combiner is taken from the next-to-last argument.
If no combiner function is found, an assertion error is thrown: 'createSelector expects an output function after the inputs, but received: [type]'.
Empty or single input selector arrays are supported; behavior depends on getDependencies.
memoizeOptions and argsMemoizeOptions are normalized via ensureIsArray to handle both array and single-argument forms.
Dev-mode checks (identityFunctionCheck, inputStabilityCheck) only run when process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' and firstRun controls their execution schedule.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Throws an AssertionError if the final functional argument is missing or not a function: 'createSelector expects an output function after the inputs, but received: [typeof resultFunc]'.

detail.summary: Creates a memoized selector from a set of input selectors and a combiner function, recomputing the result only when any input selector's result changes.

detail.name: recomputationWrapper
preconditions: The underlying selector function and its memoization cache must be initialized.
The dependencies passed must be resolvable for equality comparison.
A memoization strategy (memoize or argsMemoize) must be configured.
postconditions: If dependencies have not changed since last invocation, returns the previously computed result without re-executing the selector.
If dependencies have changed, recomputes the result by invoking the source selector with the current dependencies.
The returned function preserves the signature of the original selector via Parameters<AnyFunction>.
invariants: The wrapper does not alter the return type of the wrapped selector.
Memoization state is preserved across calls as long as the wrapper instance exists.
The selector is only recomputed when at least one dependency value differs from its prior reference.
edgeCases: When invoked with no prior cached state, the selector executes immediately and caches the result.
When dependencies are referentially equal to the last call, the cached result is returned regardless of internal value changes.
When the memoization cache is evicted or reconfigured, the next call forces recomputation.
stateMutations: Updates the internal memoization cache with the latest dependencies and computed result when a recomputation occurs.
detail.summary: Wraps the selector's execution to control recomputation by deciding whether to invoke the source function or return a cached result based on dependency equality.

specTests.when: The wrapper is invoked with a set of dependency values.
specTests.then: The selector executes and caches the result for subsequent calls.
The cached result is returned without re-executing the selector.

specTests.when: The wrapper detects a dependency change.
specTests.then: The selector recomputes and the new result is cached.

detail.name: dependenciesChecker
preconditions: The selector must be invoked within a valid Redux/state context where dependency input selectors are resolvable.
process.env.NODE_ENV must be accessible if dev-mode checks are enabled.
postconditions: On each invocation, dependencyRecomputations is incremented by one.
Input selector results are collected and passed to the memoized result function.
If not in production and identityFunctionCheck shouldRun, identityFunctionCheck.run is invoked with the result function, input selector results, and last result.
invariants: dependencyRecomputations reflects the total number of times dependenciesChecker has been called.
lastResult is updated before dev-mode checks are executed.
The first invocation sets firstRun to true, influencing dev-mode check behavior on subsequent calls.
edgeCases: When arguments are unchanged across calls, argsMemoize skips re-traversal of dependencies.
When process.env.NODE_ENV is 'production', dev-mode checks are skipped entirely.
When identityFunctionCheck.shouldRun is false, the identity check is not executed even in non-production environments.
stateMutations: firstRun (set to false after first invocation via external context)
detail.summary: Wraps input selector collection and memoization to recompute selector results only when dependencies change, incrementing a recomputation counter and optionally running dev-mode checks on the first call.
